title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Determining product mix, stock and price levels for goods to be sold;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Purchasing and ordering goods for sale from markets, wholesalers and other suppliers;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Budgeting and maintaining records of stock levels and financial transactions;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Determining prices and displaying goods for sale;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Selling goods to customers and advising them on product use;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Examining returned goods and deciding on appropriate action;

title: Shopkeepers
task_text: Taking inventory of goods in stock.

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Planning and preparing work schedules and assigning staff to specific duties;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Instructing staff on sales procedures, including how to handle difficult or complex cases;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Ensuring that customers receive prompt service;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Participating in and providing advice to managers on interviewing, hiring, training, evaluating, promoting and dismissing staff, and resolving staff grievances;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Examining returned goods and deciding on appropriate action;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Taking inventory of goods for sale and ordering new stock;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Ensuring that goods and services are correctly priced and displayed;

title: Shop Supervisors
task_text: Ensuring that safety procedures are enforced.

title: Shop Sales Assistants
task_text: Determining customer requirements and advising on product range, price, delivery, warranties and product use and care;

title: Shop Sales Assistants
task_text: Demonstrating and explaining to customers the establishment's goods and services;

title: Shop Sales Assistants
task_text: Selling goods and services, accepting payment by a variety of payment methods, preparing sales invoices and recording sales using cash registers;

title: Shop Sales Assistants
task_text: Assisting with the ongoing management of stock such as product inventories and participating in stock takes;

title: Shop Sales Assistants
task_text: Stacking and displaying goods for sale, and wrapping and packing goods sold.
